units.source_text: 正在寂寞无聊之时，左大臣家的三位中将来访。

en.t: Just as he was feeling lonely and bored, the Sangi Chujo from the household of the Minister of the Left came to visit.

units.source_text: 这中将现已升任宰相，人品优越，时望隆重。

en.t: This Chujo had now been promoted to counselor; his character was excellent, and his reputation in the world was very high.

units.source_text: 但常感这世间枯燥无味，遇事就惦念源氏公子，

en.t: Yet he often found the world dull and empty, and whenever anything happened he thought of Prince Genji,

units.source_text: 便顾不得为此要被处罪，毅然地赶到须磨来了。

en.t: so he gave no thought to the punishment he might suffer for it and resolutely hurried to Suma.

units.source_text: 两人久别重逢，悲喜交集，真所谓“一样泪流两不分”了。

en.t: After their long separation, the two met again with joy and sorrow mingled together, truly as if their tears flowed alike and could not be told apart.

units.source_text: 宰相看看源氏公子的居处，觉得很像中国式样。

en.t: The counselor looked over Prince Genji's dwelling and thought it seemed very Chinese in style.
The scenery all around was quiet, pure, and as beautiful as a painting.

units.source_text: 真是“石阶桂柱竹编墙”，一切简单朴素，别有风味。

en.t: It was truly a place of stone steps, katsura pillars, and bamboo-woven walls; everything was simple and plain, yet it had a distinctive charm.

units.source_text: 源氏公子打扮得像个山农野老，穿着淡红透黄的衬衣，

en.t: Prince Genji was dressed like an old farmer from the hills, wearing an underrobe of pale red with yellow showing through,

units.source_text: 上罩深蓝色便服和裙子，样子甚是寒酸。

en.t: with a dark blue informal robe and trousers over it, so that he looked quite poor and shabby.

units.source_text: 虽然像个乡下人，但是别具风度，教人看了含笑，觉得非常清雅。

en.t: Though he looked like a countryman, he had a grace all his own, making those who saw him smile and feel that he was extraordinarily refined.

units.source_text: 日常使用的器具也都很粗陋。

en.t: The utensils he used every day were also all very crude.

units.source_text: 所住的房室很浅，从外望去，一目了然。

en.t: The rooms where he lived were shallow, so that from outside one could take them in at a glance.

units.source_text: 棋盘、双六盘、弹棋盘，都是乡下产的粗货。

en.t: The go board, the sugoroku board, and the dangi board were all rough articles made in the countryside.

units.source_text: 看到念珠等供佛之具，想见他日常勤修佛法。

en.t: Seeing the rosary and other Buddhist implements, one could tell that he diligently practiced the Buddhist teachings day by day.

units.source_text: 所吃的食物，也都是田家风味，却颇有趣致。

en.t: Even the food he ate had the flavor of a farmhouse, yet it was quite charming in its own way.
